humanCheckpoints.name: Marginal Deal Viability Review
humanCheckpoints.trigger: Borrower metrics fall in grey area (e.g. 580-620 FICO with $1M revenue)
humanCheckpoints.rationale: Rules handle clear passes and hard declines. Borderline credits require business narrative inspection.

humanCheckpoints.name: AI Executive Credit Memo Sign-Off
humanCheckpoints.trigger: AI synthesizes financial statements and outputs draft narrative
humanCheckpoints.rationale: AI may misinterpret one-off anomalous deposits or tax adjustments. Human sign-off verifies institutional credibility.

humanCheckpoints.name: Lender Target List & Strategy Approval
humanCheckpoints.rationale: Prevents redundant or conflicting submissions across lender syndicates that could harm borrower reputation.

humanCheckpoints.name: Offer Evaluation & Borrower Counseling
humanCheckpoints.trigger: Lender issues Term Sheet or LOI
humanCheckpoints.rationale: Advising on interest rates, covenants, personal guarantees, and amortization terms requires human empathy and tactical judgment.
